messages:
Lina (CS): Quick draft of a 1-page SMB handoff runbook — focus: prefill, stream-first UX, simple renewal hooks. Pls quick feedback.

Ravi (SE): include a tiny prefill example + stream-first fallback. Keep snippets copy-paste ready.

Lina (CS): PREFILL EXAMPLE:
```json
{"customer":"org-xyz","prefill":"recent_convos","prompt":"Summarize user's last 5 tickets"}
```
BATCH DEFAULTS: max_batch=8, max_latency_ms=40, per_client_concurrency=4.

Ravi (SE): STREAM FALLBACK (pseudo):
```js
const s = await client.stream('/chat',{firstTokenTimeout:3000});
if (!s.firstToken) await client.request('/chat',{body,fast_mode:true});
```

Marco (Platform): add headers: X-Cache-Hit, X-Batch-Size, X-Model-Variant, X-Stream-Fallback. Recommend Retry-After and jittered backoff (base 500ms).

Lina (CS): RENEWAL HOOKS: flag if tokens down 14d OR feature usage dips. Send 1Q pulse after day7: "Useful? Yes/No" -> webhook event cs_pulse_response.

AE-bot: Action: publish AE one-pager in /customer-playbooks/smb within 48h ✅

Lina (CS): I'll collate and make the slide. Thanks — scheduling 15m with AEs next Tue.
